name: Gadgetzan
summary: Trade brings both factions to Gadgetzan, where the Steamwheedle Cartel keeps the peace. Anyone may enter, provided they bring coin or work to offer.

sections.title: A Bastion of Profit in the Dunes
sections.body:
Amid Tanaris's scorching sands, Gadgetzan is the Steamwheedle Cartel's base for trade in southern Kalimdor. Goblin ingenuity gives its buildings a haphazard shape. Within them are an auction house, a bank, an inn, and workshops for engineers, blacksmiths, and alchemists.

Flight masters carry travelers of both factions toward Tanaris, Feralas, and the basin of Un'Goro. Commerce rules here. Keep your weapons sheathed and your purse open, and the goblins will let you pass in peace.

sections.title: Desert Troubles and Enforced Order
sections.body: Goblin bruisers keep order in Gadgetzan. They pummel anyone who threatens trade or starts a faction brawl. Beyond the gates, the Gadgetzan Water Company struggles against Wastewander bandits at Waterspring Field. Water is precious in Tanaris, so the cartel hires mercenaries to defeat the bandit leaders and recover water pouches. The town's reservoirs depend on that supply.

faq.q: Can Alliance and Horde attack each other in Gadgetzan?
aliases: can horde and alliance fight here
faq.answer: No. The Steamwheedle Cartel keeps Gadgetzan strictly neutral. Goblin bruisers patrol the town and attack anyone who breaks the peace or harms other travelers.

faq.q: Why is water such a big deal around here?
faq.answer: Gadgetzan depends on water from the extraction towers of the Gadgetzan Water Company at Waterspring Field. Wastewander bandits have overrun the wells and cut off the town's main supply. So the goblins offer bounties for stolen water pouches.
The Steamwheedle Cartel owns and governs Gadgetzan. It is Azeroth's largest and most prominent mercantile goblin organization.

faq.q: What makes the auction house here special?
faq.answer: Gadgetzan's neutral auction house lets Alliance and Horde buy and sell goods to each other. The goblins charge a much higher transaction fee for this privilege.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can find advanced trainers and specialized schematics in Gadgetzan. The town also has an arrival teleportation pad calibrated for gnomish engineers.
As a blacksmith, you can use Gadgetzan's heavy-duty forges and anvils, favored by advanced metalworkers. The town is a key staging ground for members of the Mithril Order.
